A one trillion parameter AI, and most of it stays asleep.
This is Mistral Large 4, in public preview since October 6th. Its nickname: le Chonk.
It has one trillion parameters, but only forty-nine billion are active at any moment.
Mistral labels it a mixture of experts: a router picks which expert blocks fire for each token, and the rest stay idle.
So you get a giant's knowledge at roughly a smaller model's running cost.
Mistral trained it from scratch on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs, in its own European data centres.
On Cybench, forty security challenges, Mistral says it solves ninety-three percent, among the best open-model scores.
Weights are due by the end of October, so organisations can host it themselves.
The catch: these are Mistral's own numbers. Independent tests must still confirm them.
